name: Synth Riders: Crypt of The NecroDancer Music Pack
summary:
Descend into the rhythm with a brand new music pack for Synth Riders, featuring official tracks from the acclaimed soundtrack of Crypt of The NecroDancer.
Every track is authentically brought into the game, delivering fast-paced beats, challenging patterns, and an atmosphere that blends dark fantasy with neon energy.

Set List by Danny Baranowsky:
- Disco Descent
- Konga Conga Kappa
- Rhythmortis
- Fungal Funk
- Styx and Stones
